summary: Fix a fleet-map copy bug reported as 'Set up does nothing' on the offline-basemap download banner. Investigation on a live instance showed the setup dialog itself works fine, but its save button read 'Save plan' - borrowed from the unrelated floor-designer component (fd.save) - which made a dialog about a remote pmtiles map source look like it belonged to something else and read as a dead end. asset_wizard.js's SiteDialog (save a site's name + glyph) had the exact same borrowed-label bug. Both now use their own keys: map.saveSource ('Save source') on the basemap setup dialog, map.saveAsset ('Save') on the site dialog; the now-unused fd.save key is removed (the floor designer autosaves and has no save button of its own). Two further clarity gaps found during the investigation are also addressed: saving a source only stores the URL and downloads nothing - the actual download is a separate step, offered afterward on the same banner as 'Download this region' - so map.sourceSaved now names that next step explicitly instead of just confirming the save; and BasemapDownloadBanner gained a hasTool prop (from GET /api/basemap/config's hasTool, wired through fleet_map.js) so that when a source is configured but the pmtiles binary isn't installed on the server, the banner shows map.toolMissing instead of offering a Download button that would fail every time with no explanation.
compatibility: Frontend-only copy/UI fix; no API, schema, or config changes. Backward compatible for existing installs - GET /api/basemap/config already returned hasTool, this just wires an existing field into a prop that wasn't previously read at this callsite. All four i18n dicts (en/ms/zh/ar) updated together and hold an identical key set; fd.save had no remaining callers after this change.
